sentences.text:
Premchandra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. on 16
February, 2024
Author: Pankaj Bhatia

Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:13917
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 12053 of 2023
Applicant :- Premchandra

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Dhananjay Trivedi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. It is argued that the co accused namely Subhash on the similar allegations has been enlarged on bail vide order dated 24.1.2024.
The applicant is in jail since 7.6.2023 and the applicant has no criminal history, hence the applicant may be released on bail on the ground of parity.

3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail by arguing that there are witnesses to the incident,
hence the prayer for bail should be rejected but could not deny the ground of parity.

4. Considering the fact that the co accused on similar allegations has been enlarged on bail by this Court coupled with the fact that the applicant is in jail since 7.6.2023 having no criminal history and Premchandra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Premchandra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail on the ground of parity.
5.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Premchandra be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.367 of 2023, under Sections 376-D, 458 I.P.C., Police Station Laharpur, District Sitapur on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions :-
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 16.2.2024 Shukla  Premchandra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/52924107/
